test: MIDI AudioWorklet continues real PCM during a main-thread stall
backend: Codex in-app browser, AudioWorklet, isolated wasm-bindgen MidiSynth
reproduce: Build web/pkg, serve repository root, open tools/midi-audio-probe.html, select a legal SF2 bank and original MIDI, start, then trigger the 2-second stall.
limits: Measures continuous nonzero PCM synthesis in the audio thread. It does not certify speaker hardware, original Windows synth timbre or every browser. Meter granularity and 100 ms observation delay surround the 2-second stall.

persistedMidiColdStart.procedure: Options → MIDI → return to title → reload page → hosted play
persistedMidiColdStart.observedBy: Root browser QA against readiness-fixed release package
